authoritative_followup_status_note: The route keeps one visible authoritative status/help lane for cases where device-local or queue-pending state has not yet become office-side truth.
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes that may save state locally or queue later send/repair keep local-only state, queued-for-send state, and office-acknowledged state visibly separate enough that the voter does not mistake device memory for official receipt.
local_only_state_note: When progress exists only in the current browser, app, or device, the route labels that state as local-only rather than implying official receipt.
local_state_truthfulness_surface_label: Example State official voter-information local-only / queued / office-acknowledged state truthfulness policy
local_vs_office_receipt_boundary_note: Device-local drafts, local reference tokens, or volatile optimistic clears are not presented as proof that the office has received the request.
office_acknowledged_state_note: The route uses stronger submission/receipt language only after the authoritative service has actually received or accepted the action.
portable_record_boundary_note: Portable records distinguish device-local state from actual office acknowledgment and do not treat local save artifacts as final submission receipts.
queued_or_repair_pending_state_note: If the route queues later send or repair after connectivity returns, the UI keeps that queue-pending state distinct from office acceptance.
restart_return_continuity_note: After restart, hidden return, or resume, the route preserves enough continuity cues that the voter can still tell whether the prior state was local-only, queue-pending, or office-acknowledged.
retry_behavior_note: Retry guidance changes with the true state class so the voter can tell when retry resumes a local draft, re-attempts a queued send, risks duplication, or is unnecessary because the request already landed.
